The '''Aurea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]].
